coverageNotes: The Secretary of the State’s statewide November 3, 2026 List of Nominees covers all 5 statewide contests, 5 U.S. House districts, 36 state Senate districts and 151 state House districts. Every listed nomination and registered write-in candidate is included.
Fusion nominations remain separate party lines. The joint Governor and Lieutenant Governor ticket is retained as printed in one candidacy per party line.
The official nomination list does not state incumbency or campaign websites.

The Secretary of the State’s complete November 3, 2026 election-management ballot-question dataset, version 45337, contains 57 local questions in 23 municipalities and no statewide question. Statewide measure coverage is confirmed from that complete official question inventory.
